body: Growth and expansion are tied to a sharp sense of truth and integrity; you achieve when the cause is authentic and stall when it isn't.
business: Principled, high-integrity expansion; unstoppable behind a real conviction.
shadow: All-or-nothing about your own truth, tipping into dogma or self-righteousness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Authored from supplied modern-point aspect file.
